majors.issue: The water-tower compound is the same stamp on both shanty seeds: water tower, firepit, teal-roof stall and blue-awning counter on the same concrete patch, arranged pixel-for-pixel alike. Last round's 'shared water-tower compound reused across layouts' is fixed for settlement but has moved to the shanty type, so the two shanty seeds still share their only landmark.
majors.fix: Build the compound per seed from a pool (tower/no tower, stall vs scrap shed, firepit position, slab shape), or give shanty its own landmark set separate from settlement.

majors.issue: The compound still reads as a left/right mirror: identical small shacks on each side of the central shack, two identical tire-and-scrap piles placed symmetrically above the top fence, fence runs with matching central gaps top and bottom, matching post columns at x~360 and x~725, plus two identical water towers. The right edge also has two identical car husks stacked vertically about 250px apart.
majors.fix: Break the symmetry: use different shack variants, offset the fence gaps, keep one tire pile, use one water tower per compound, and pick a different husk variant or a different prop for the second husk.

majors.issue: The top row repeats the same ruined two-storey building stamp twice on the same street line (~270px apart, same crop, same rubble), and the same blue sedan appears twice on the one east-west road and the same green truck twice on the north-south road. The 'identical stamps near each other' item is not fully gone.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-C/s1-top.png (settlement-1 x100-620,y80-200, buildings at x~130 and x~400); /tmp/vqa-r7-C/s1-road.png (sedans at x~425 and x~630)
majors.fix: Do not reuse a building variant within N cells on the same frontage; vary vehicle models/damage per instance.

majors.issue: The middle shack row is an even grid with a mirrored pair: the same rust shack sits on both sides of the blue container shack, and a second blue-shack-with-tent pair repeats the same combo ~260px to the left. It reads as one stamp copied, not an organic shanty town.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-C/sh3-row.png (shanty-3 x300-608,y180-300); blue shack + tent at x~160 and x~418, y~245 in the overview
majors.fix: Vary shack variants by neighbour, jitter spacing and rows, and stop placing the same shack+tent combo more than once.

majors.issue: The mine adit is still a free-standing stone-arched box on flat dirt in both seeds, with no hillside, cliff face or spoil heap behind it. Last round's major is not fixed. In mining-2 it also sits dead centre with two identical boulder piles flanking it symmetrically and a third copy of the same pile below.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-C/m7-yard.png (adit lower right); /tmp/vqa-r7-C/m2-yard.png (adit top centre, boulders left/right/bottom right)
majors.fix: Place the adit at the yard edge against a terrace cliff or forest rock face (or add a rock-mound backing piece), and vary or limit the boulder-pile variants to one per yard.

majors.issue: Each vine plot still has a single golden/orange cell in its bottom-right corner (5 of 6 plots across the two seeds), and the plots are hard rectangles of identical 16px vine squares that read as lettuce trays on bare dirt. The two seeds also use the exact same kit (winery, 3 plots, barrel rack, press, grape baskets) in only slightly reshuffled positions.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-C/v3-yard.png (gold cell at bottom right of each plot); /tmp/vqa-r7-C/v8-yard.png (same)
majors.fix: Remove the corner-cell special or scatter it irregularly; run vine rows as long trellis lines with varied lengths rather than grid blocks; vary plot count, orientation and prop set per seed.

majors.issue: The flagstone yard is still a bright, complete crazy-paving slab with a crisp raised rim and a stepped rectangular outline. No missing stones, no grass-filled gaps or soil showing through, so it still reads as freshly paved. The only weathering is bush stamps placed on top.
majors.fix: Add broken/missing-stone variants with grass and soil showing, darken and moss-tint stones toward the edges, and break the outer rim into irregular, partly sunken edges.

minors.issue: Cells 5-8 contain pothole fragments touching the cell top and bottom edges (half-holes). Harmless if they are always placed as a multi-cell pair, but a single placement would show a cut hole.
minors.fix: Ensure the composer places these only as complete groups, or keep each decal inside one cell.

minors.issue: The central parking lot has a one-cell dirt strip along its top and bottom inside the slab, which looks like a fill error rather than design.
minors.fix: Close the slab, or make the strip a broken kerb/planter.

minors.issue: Short free-standing fence runs with nothing to enclose (x~145-240,y~150 and x~500-580,y~487 between concrete posts).
minors.fix: Attach these fences to a structure or drop them.

minors.issue: Through the main temple's colonnade the yard flagstone shows where the cella should be, so the temple reads as a hollow facade.
minors.fix: Put a dark interior or rubble floor inside the temple.

minors.issue: The road jog sidewalks now connect. The asphalt mottle is acceptable, with no visible bead texture or repeat at 1x.
